title: Ancient star collisions could explain mysterious Little Red Dots and 'impossible' black holes
caption:
New simulations explain how the universe's first black holes grew so fast. In the crowded early cosmos, stars merged like raindrops to create massive seeds that James Webb is finally spotting.

Source: Space - Ancient star collisions could explain mysterious Little Red Dots and 'impossible' black holes
